title: Cherry Magic! Thirty Years of Virginity Can Make You a Wizard?!
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: Salaryman Kiyoshi Adachi turns thirty still a virgin and gains the power to hear the thoughts of anyone he touches. He learns that his handsome, popular coworker Yuichi Kurosawa is in love with him, and as he hears how much Kurosawa values him, Adachi slowly develops feelings in return. A side romance follows Adachi's novelist friend Tsuge.
life_message: Being truly known and valued by someone can help an insecure person accept love and himself.

content.note: Same-sex romance; ANN reviewers (cited in Wikipedia) note Kurosawa's explicit fantasies yet call it tame for its mature rating; MU Mature genre.
Possible office drinking; not documented (to verify).
Adachi's lack of self-confidence is a central struggle (author via Wikipedia).
Mind-reading by touch raises privacy questions in-story.
